sections.section: RULES - Balochistan Forest Department Executive (Grade 1 To 15) Service Rules 1982
sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN FOREST DEPARTMENT EXECUTIVE
BALOCHISTAN FOREST DEPARTMENT EXECUTIVE
(GRADE 1 TO 15) SERVICE RULES, 1982
(Substitution of Serial Nos.2 and 3 in the
appendix)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
28th August, 2012]
No.S.O.(R-II)(6)1/2012-S&GAD/1525-75,
dated 28-8-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 25 of the
Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act No.IX of 1974), the Government of
Balochistan is pleased to make the following amendments in the Balochistan
Forest Department Executive (Grade 1 to 15) Service Rules, 1982, namely:--
In
the aforesaid rules, in appendix, for Serial Nos.2 and 3, the following shall
be substituted, namely:
2
Forester (BPS-7)
(a) Secondary School
Certificate (Second Division) from a recognized Board; and (b) Three years' Diploma
in Forestry from a recognized Institute.
(a) 60% by initial
recruitment; and (b) 40% by promotion from amongst the members of the Service
holding the post of Forest Guard (BPS-5) having at least three (3) years'
service as such, on seniority cum fitness basis.
3.
Forest Guard (BPS-5)
(a) Secondary School
Certificate from a recognized Board; and (b) Six months' course from a
recognized Forest Institute.
By Initial
recruitment.
